limitations: The prior executable proves exact both-seat controller/observation/sensor/upstream parity only through first native choice; the suffix is new physics.
The fixed 20 selected historical neutral alternatives are correlated and conditional. The 62-candidate denominator remains explicit; unknown candidates were not added to this continuation study.
Only four current chosen sites admit numeric medians; the other sixteen physically continue with unknown local references. Successful unknown trips are not numeric error samples.

Six first-attempt observations stop at destination revision changes before landing. Their landing intervals are interrupted, later phases not started; these stops are not measured physical failures or completed costs.
No observation-horizon, match-end, recovery, inner-retry or death endpoint occurs in this corpus. These remain supported/tested observer variants without physical coverage here.

No enemy-flag walking, calibration fit, live permission, policy-strength or device-performance claim follows. Departure is the existing coordinator milestone; touchdown does not require exact site-pose equality.
All351 near-tied departure-side directions remain unresolved by independent solar reconstruction; clearance signs and the selected site/side winners are checked separately.
